facts.note: Watches shown when the temple struck nine. Narrator's watch exact; Félix 20 min behind; Girard 4 min behind; doctor 2 min ahead.
After dinner she worked beside the master in the atelier. At the temple's ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly.
He sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; it was running then and he was well.
In the kitchen she compared her watch with Rosa's clock, which was exactly fifteen minutes fast.
Piano heard from the kitchen; began at 12 minutes to eleven and stopped at 1 minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock.
Went straight down to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the temple struck eleven.
